sources.detail: All 6 live pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched by direct curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB. Parsed <table class="tier-list"> rows (first <td> = tier letter; each <span class="tier-list-entry"> block's FIRST img alt = "Spec Class"). 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec once per page, tiers S/A+/A/B/C. Era-verified per <title>: "Midnight DPS Rankings: Raiding Tier List (Midnight (12.0.7))", "...(Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight)", "...(Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1)"; Devourer present in both DPS lists; no page self-IDs as Season 2. The pages' OWN dates are unchanged and still trail our fetch (JSON-LD dateModified 2026-07-01 raid DPS / 2026-06-30 raid healer+tank / 2026-07-01 all three M+), so this is a live re-verification of a static upstream list, not new editorial movement: 0 tier moves vs committed.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 221-358 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)", never Season 1. Six-band scale seen intact (S/A+/A/B+/B/C; B+ present on all three pages). 40 rows: 38 rated + the 2 upstream TBDs written as EXPLICIT nulls — Augmentation Evoker (DPS page) and Vengeance Demon Hunter (tank page), both re-confirmed in this fetch rather than assumed. 0 tier moves. The page's own date is unchanged (JSON-LD dateModified 2026-07-26T10:53 on all three), so sources.json published stays 2026-07-26 while snapshot advances; upstream rebuilds Sundays 14:00 CEST, so a 7-day lag is the documented normal and not yet the ~2-week freeze that would be a finding. Never enters the consensus (era-gated in the registry).

Both pages fetched live by direct curl, HTTP 200 (149 KB raid / 161 KB M+). Parsed the tier__tier blocks (tier__title letter + data-original-title spec names). Era-verified: raid page 3 "Season 1" / 6 "Midnight" hits, M+ page 2 / 10, and 0 "Season 2" hits on either. Raid 39 rows (Vengeance DH still omitted upstream — the longstanding absence, not a parse loss) + M+ 40 = 79 rows, 0 unmatched. The 8 rejected strings on the M+ page are its dungeon tier list (Windrunner Spire, Pit of Saron, Magister's Terrace, Maisara Caverns, Seat of the Triumvirate, Nexus Point Xenas, Skyreach, Algeth'ar Academy), correctly excluded. Distributions byte-match committed (raid S7/A12/B10/C10, M+ A15/B19/C6): 0 tier moves.

All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 80-315 KB, direct curl with the full browser header set (Accept, Accept-Language, sec-ch-ua*, sec-fetch-*, upgrade-insecure-requests). Parsed the [tier-list=rows] block out of the raw document after unescaping \/ to /, splitting on [tier] and reading each block's [tier-label bg=qN]TIER[/tier-label] plus its [spec-badge=<slug>] entries — note the D and F tiers carry their label INSIDE [tier-content], so anchoring on label-then-content order drops them. 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, M+ DPS A+ tier present (4 specs); raid DPS S and all D/F tiers are genuinely empty upstream, same shape as committed. Era-verified: every <title> reads "for Midnight Season 1"; 0 "Season 2" occurrences inside any tier block. 0 tier moves.

All 6 tier pages (raid mythic/all-bosses + M+ 10/all-dungeons/this-week x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched as raw HTML and parsed from the <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> JSON; raid read from the metric:"throughput" tierList (NOT the default popularity grouping), M+ from metric:"score". 80 rows, 0 unresolved. REAL UPSTREAM RECLUSTER: 13 raid tier moves, all one band down (S->A for Balance Druid, Marksmanship, Windwalker, Survival, Havoc; A->B for Elemental, Enhancement, Arms, Destruction, Subtlety, Unholy, Devastation, Demonology), while the underlying 95th-pct DPS values moved at most 0.44% — Archon's Ckmeans boundaries tightened (raid DPS S went 7 specs -> 2: only Augmentation 183.6k and Devourer 179.9k). Values verified monotonically decreasing across S>A>B>C, so the throughput list was read correctly. M+ 0 moves. Page lastUpdated reads 2026-08-01T12:00:00Z (Archon publishes daily at 12:00 UTC; this 02:5xZ run predates today's rebuild).

All 17 encounters re-fetched across all THREE roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 with a parseable __NEXT_DATA__: 9 raid bosses (imperator, vorasius, salhadaar, vaelgor-ezzorak, vanguard, crown, chimaerus, beloren, midnight-falls) from the throughput tierList and 8 dungeons (algethar-academy, magisters, maisara-caverns, nexus-point-xenas, pit-of-saron, seat, skyreach, windrunner-spire) from the score tierList. 40/40 specs per encounter, 680 tier cells total (the committed count), 0 unresolved. 40 of 680 cells moved — ordinary daily churn, and consistent with the same Ckmeans reclustering seen in the all-bosses list. Encounter display names deliberately preserved from committed data (Archon's encounterOptions labels are ActorIcon markup, not plain names). asOf 2026-08-02.

Read from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three raid mythic/all-bosses pages (the same fetch as archon-tiers), giving all 40 specs across DPS/Healer/Tank. 40 rows merged via apply-metrics.mjs survivability key, 0 unresolved. 2 moves: Destruction Warlock A->B (86.2%) and Fury Warrior B->C (84.3%). Values are Archon's death-rate-derived percentages (range 81.6-90.3 for the raid DPS list), sane and monotonic within each band.

33 "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" rows (27 DPS + 6 tank specs) read from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[] on the raid DPS and Tank pages — NOT from tierList, which carries only letters. Kept the two standing parser lessons: the dps/hps fields are FLOATS (175545.41536857) so they are rounded to the stored integer convention, and each row's parses is the series' n (omitting it silently deletes n from every stored row). All 33 values moved, max single-row move 0.44% (Guardian Druid 105668 -> 106132), range 89421-183590 — plausible magnitudes, no popularity/DPS column mix-up.

7 "95th pct HPS (Mythic)" rows from the raid Healer page's specRankingsSection table (hps column, floats rounded, n = parses). All 7 moved by <=0.32% (Mistweaver 214702 -> 214913, Discipline 210147 -> 210809), range 187096-214913 — healer magnitudes, cleanly distinct from the DPS series.

40 "M+ score (95th pct)" rows from the three mythic-plus/10/all-dungeons/this-week pages' specRankingsSection tables, all 40 specs, 0 unresolved. Values in the 3.4k-4.3k Raider.IO-score range (Augmentation 4256 top, Devourer DH 4196), no DPS magnitudes; unchanged from committed this run, which is consistent with Archon's daily 12:00 UTC rebuild not yet having run when this 02:5xZ fetch landed.

80 "Popularity" rows (40 raid + 40 M+) from the popularity fraction in specRankingsSection.table.data[], multiplied by 100 and rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention (rounding to 4 decimals rewrites all 80 rows for nothing). Kept the shape check that caught the three-night raid-half corruption: every value is a plausible percentage (raid 0.5-10.2, M+ 0.3-38.4), none carries a DPS magnitude, and no row equals its spec's 95th-pct DPS.

Fetched correctly via the JSON API, never the stale S3 HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both HTTP 200 on plain curl with no headers/proxy/auth. Whitelisted categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === lowerBound AND keyRange === undefined (never merely blacklisting "dungeon": melee and ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs) -> exactly 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 40/40 classSpec names byte-identical to the roster. PARTIAL because upstream snapshotDate is STILL 2026-07-28 — a fifth consecutive day (completedAt 2026-07-28T22:06:44Z, pipeline steps unchanged) — and asOf is the source's date, never today. All 40 lowerBound values re-verified byte-identical at 2-decimal precision (rounding them to integers falsely reports 39 of 40 as moved), so stored data is deliberately untouched. maxAgeDays is 8, so this is now 5 days in and worth a human's attention if it does not advance.

Transport itself is healthy (oauth true, graphql true, 1/3600 points spent). This agent holds NO WCL credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means. The 47 stored "Median rDPS/HPS (Mythic, ...)" rows are untouched at their existing dates.

All 3 meta pages (dps/healer/tank, /meta/<role>/m+) fetched by plain GET with a browser UA — r.jina.ai does NOT work on murlok — HTTP 200, 41-72 KB. Parsed by segmenting the document between consecutive class="...meta-item" anchor OPENING tags (keeping the href for the cross-check) and reading each block's second .h3 (the "Spec Class" display name) plus the first number after its </svg>. 40/40 rows, 0 unmatched, range 3738-4350. Era-verified: 7 "Season 1" hits, 0 "Season 2". 0 values moved this run — murlok re-aggregates every 8h and the top-50 ceiling is slow-moving late in a settled season, so an unchanged read is an honest no-op, not a stale transport. Still labelled a top-50 ceiling, never popularity.

26 of 27 DPS specs fetched from bloodmallet.com/chart/get/talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk/<snake_class>/<snake_spec>, all HTTP 200. Augmentation Evoker skipped because its chart carries no simc_settings.tier == "MID1" (an upstream absence, the same as previous runs, not a parse error). Kept both standing gotchas: simc_settings.ptr is the STRING "0" (truthy in JS — compare explicitly or all 26 profiles are thrown away), and the target map is data.MID1[<targetCount>], already best-build (treating data[<count>] as the top level yields 0 profiles from 26 successful 200s and looks exactly like an outage). All 26 profiles byte-identical to committed at counts 1/2/3/5/8/15 — the upstream sim batch has not re-run (timestamps still 2026-07-08 for 25 specs and 2026-07-15 for Elemental), so this is a live re-verification, not new sims.

headings, mapping the 40 profile names to specs by LONGEST-PREFIX roster match (MID1_Death_Knight_Frost_Rider has underscores in both class and spec, so a fixed 3-group regex maps nothing) and keeping the best build per spec -> 26 specs, 0 unresolved. mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched via r.jina.ai (HTTP 200) and the parse bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section only — an unbounded regex over the whole page picks up the comps and Gini blocks and yields 58 bogus rows. Still period 1074, but the window has MOVED: 2000 keys / 10000 characters, 3651 unique (was 5080) at 22.1 average key level (was 21.3), and 31 of 39 values moved — the top-2000 cut tightening onto higher keys as the season ends. Biggest shifts: Mistweaver 11.5 -> 14.6, Devourer DH 12.6 -> 14.4, Augmentation 9.0 -> 12.8, Retribution 5.0 -> 3.4, Restoration Shaman 7.3 -> 4.6. Devastation Evoker STILL has no bar on the chart (a genuine upstream absence); writing a 0 would be an inference, so its 2026-07-30 row was left alone -> 40 stored / 39 fresh, coverage date 2026-08-02.
